connection_info.title: Connection information
connection_info.description:
Scale ID: `{scale_id}`

Local webhook path: `{webhook_path}`

Use these values when configuring the local measurement transport. The webhook accepts POST requests from the local network only.

sparky_settings.title: SparkyFitness settings
sparky_settings.description: Optional base URL shared by the profiles of this scale. API keys remain separate for each profile. Leave empty only when synchronization is disabled for every profile.

data_description.sparky_url: Example: https://sparky.example.com. Do not include /api/health-data. HTTPS is recommended because API keys are sent to this server.

add_profile.title: Add profile
add_profile.description: The scale sends the four-digit PIN with every completed measurement. Each PIN can belong to only one profile.

data_description.profile_pin: Exactly four digits. Leading zeroes are preserved.
data_description.date_of_birth: Age is calculated separately for the date of each measurement.
data_description.athlete_mode: Off maps to native activity value 0; on maps to value 5.
data_description.reference_standard: External/international is the normal default outside China.
data_description.sparky_enabled: Queues the newest accepted measurement for each profile and local date for restart-safe background delivery.
data_description.sparky_api_key: Token only, without the Bearer prefix. The key must have the health_data_write permission.
